parameters.code: var map=UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<Arena.ArenaMap>();var parent=UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("Original doodad positions - CC0 substitutes").transform;int n=0;float error=0;foreach(UnityEngine.Transform p in parent){var d=map.Layout.doodads.First(x=>p.name.StartsWith(x.id+"#"+x.editorId+" /"));error=UnityEngine.Mathf.Max(error,UnityEngine.Vector3.Distance(p.position,new UnityEngine.Vector3(d.x,d.z,d.y)/64));n++;}var terrain=UnityEngine.Terrain.activeTerrain;float heightError=0;foreach(var v in map.Layout.terrain.vertices){var point=new UnityEngine.Vector3(v.x/64,0,v.y/64);heightError=UnityEngine.Mathf.Max(heightError,UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(terrain.SampleHeight(point)+terrain.transform.position.y-v.height/64));}return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new{sourceDoodads=map.Layout.doodads.Length,visibleDoodads=n,maxPlacementErrorMeters=error,maxTerrainVertexErrorMeters=heightError,services=UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("Original service and spawn locations").transform.childCount,heroHeight=UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<Arena.ArenaGame>().Hero.GetComponentInChildren<UnityEngine.SkinnedMeshRenderer>().bounds.size.y});
